title: A Phase 1, Open-Label, Sequential, Multiple-Dose, Drug-Drug Interaction Study of Dorzagliatin and Empagliflozin in Subjects with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus

identificationModule.briefTitle: Drug Interaction Study Between Dorzagliatin and Empagliflozin
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 1, Open-Label, Sequential, Multiple-Dose, Drug-Drug Interaction Study of Dorzagliatin and Empagliflozin in Subjects with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a Phase 1, open-label, sequential, multiple-dose, drug interaction study of glucokinase activator dorzagliatin and empagliflozin in subjects with T2DM. Pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics when dorzagliatin and empagliflozin given alone and in combination will be studied.

armGroups.label: Sequential arm ABC
armGroups.description: A: Empagliflozin 25 mg QD in the morning on Days 1-5; B: Empagliflozin 25 mg in the morning and Dorzagliatin 75 mg BID (morning and evening) on Days 6-10, with only the morning dose on Day 10; C: Dorzagliatin 75 mg BID (morning and evening) on Days 11-15, with only the morning dose on Day 15.

interventions.name: Empagliflozin
interventions.description: Empagliflozin as Jardiance® 25 mg film-coated tablets for oral administration
